mapper.sql: FROM biz_process_record r LEFT JOIN biz_work_order w ON w.id = ( SELECT MAX(w2.id) FROM biz_work_order w2 WHERE w2.work_order_code = r.work_order_code AND w2.process_code = r.process_code )

WHERE ((r.submit_time >= #{q.startTime} AND r.submit_time < #{q.endTimeExclusive}) OR (r.submit_time IS NULL AND r.create_time >= #{q.startTime} AND r.create_time < #{q.endTimeExclusive}))
AND (LOCATE(#{q.product}, w.material_no) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{q.product}, w.material_name) > 0)
AND LOCATE(#{q.prodBatchNo}, w.prod_batch_no) > 0 AND LOCATE(#{q.workOrderCode}, r.work_order_code) > 0
AND (LOCATE(#{q.process}, r.process_code) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{q.process}, w.process_name) > 0)
AND (LOCATE(#{q.step}, r.step_code) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{q.step}, r.step_name) > 0)
AND (r.alg_result IS NULL OR r.alg_result NOT IN (-1, 0, 1)) AND r.alg_result = #{q.algResult}
AND NULLIF(TRIM(r.image_path), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(r.image_path), '') IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS recordCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(r.image_path), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS imageCount

SELECT t.status, COUNT(*) AS totalCount FROM ( SELECT r.work_order_code, r.process_code, MAX(w.status) AS status
GROUP BY r.work_order_code, r.process_code ) t GROUP BY t.status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(r.submit_time, r.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d') AS dateStr, COUNT(*) AS recordCount, SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(r.image_path), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS imageCount
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(r.submit_time, r.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT CASE WHEN r.alg_result IN (-1, 0, 1) THEN r.alg_result ELSE 2 END AS algResult, COUNT(*) AS totalCount
GROUP BY CASE WHEN r.alg_result IN (-1, 0, 1) THEN r.alg_result ELSE 2 END

SELECT r.process_code AS processCode, r.step_code AS stepCode, MAX(r.step_name) AS stepName, COUNT(*) AS totalCount
AND r.alg_result = 1 GROUP BY r.process_code, r.step_code ORDER BY totalCount DESC, r.process_code, r.step_code LIMIT 10

SELECT CAST(r.id AS CHAR) AS id, r.work_order_code AS workOrderCode, r.process_code AS processCode, w.process_name AS processName, r.step_code AS stepCode, r.step_name AS stepName, r.step_status AS stepStatus, r.alg_result AS algResult, r.ng_reason AS ngReason, r.image_path AS imagePath, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(r.submit_time, r.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS recordTime, w.material_no AS materialNo, w.material_name AS materialName, w.prod_batch_no AS prodBatchNo, w.prod_order_no AS prodOrderNo, w.worker_name AS workerName
ORDER BY COALESCE(r.submit_time, r.create_time) DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
